title: Gold Session Study II - Cross-Session Volatility Persistence
holdout_policy: Locked. No fetch or analysis code for this interval until all evidence gates and a separate final freeze are complete.
target: London M5 midpoint realised variance, unannualised sum of squared log returns
daily_control: Previous completed UTC weekday 00:00-24:00 realised variance; most recent valid observation age at most four calendar days
source_flat_policy: Retain genuine received flat bars; no inserted bars, interpolation, forward fill or flat-only deletion. Quote volume is recorded, not central traded volume.
estimation: OLS of log variance with intercept; exponentiate using training-only mean(exp(residual)) smearing. Clip variance forecasts below 1e-12 only. No target clipping.
development_forecasts: Expanding daily fits using only targets whose London session ended before the forecast origin; evaluate 2018-2021
validation_forecasts: Fixed coefficients and smearing fitted to 2016-2021; evaluate 2022-2023; lagged features update causally
holdout_forecasts: If authorised by evidence gates, refit once to 2016-2023 and freeze; no coefficient updates in holdout

one_conditional_trading_candidate.status: Preregistered but disabled until forecast and independent-feed gates pass
one_conditional_trading_candidate.comparison: strictly greater than linear-interpolated 80th percentile of previous 60 RV values, excluding current session
one_conditional_trading_candidate.entry: First bid boundary break; upper boundary buys at contemporaneous ask; lower boundary sells at bid; observed quote sequence required
one_conditional_trading_candidate.stop: Long exits when bid <= Asian bid low; short exits when ask >= Asian bid high
one_conditional_trading_candidate.news_filter: None; fixed exit. No historical news rule claimed.
one_conditional_trading_candidate.execution_requirement: Provider tick bid/ask replay with broker sizing; M1 may give a conservative diagnostic only, never a validated execution claim
one_conditional_trading_candidate.trading_gate: Positive net development and validation expectancy; validation 95% five-trade-block bootstrap lower bound >0 at base and doubled costs; at least 100 development and 50 validation trades; unresolved execution paths must block acceptance
